wholePhysicalScope: The named footprint fixes location and horizontal extent. The listed-building survey supplies bay counts, materials and the arrangement of the two principal elevations.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the Palladian pediment, wings, and garden stair.
limitations: Scope covers the house and its attached exterior steps. The free-standing sculptures, wider gardens and stable buildings are separate structures.
The fine reliefs, roof fittings and unsurveyed vertical dimensions are approximate.
